text.tspan: WHAT CHANGED vs R35: lift removed (lobby gone) · accessible, female and male WC all on the WEST side of the passage · lockers cut to 2 showers each and
Whole wet block (3 WC rooms + 2 locker rooms + passage) now x −1.80…7.40 = 9.2 m wide (R35: 11.5 m incl. lift lobby) → wet + service area 45.3 m² vs 56.1
m²; all drains in one zone between grid A and B.
RENTABLE: L1 + L2 = 34.3 m² (can merge or split, shopfront on the aisle) + gift shop 13.7 m² ≈ 48 m² (R35: 37.7 m²). Clinic grows to 5.0 m (between grid
S1 stair kept in place: the 1.20 m passage (x 3.20…4.40) ends with a door beside the S1 east landing. Accessible WC opens straight onto the aisle; F/M
WC and F/M lockers open onto the passage; male locker has a wet door to the pool deck.
TO CONFIRM: no lift now → upper floors (future) are not wheelchair-accessible; passage 1.20 m is the minimum; fixtures schematic — fire exits, drains,
